figma.notes: Local SVGs: 3 overlapping panels + plan cue. Import when a Figma page is available.

dimensionPolicy: UI strip below image only — never bake client mm into SVG.

semantics.customerWidthMm: Clear opening between posts — overlapping panels together cover this when closed.
semantics.overlapMm: CA-11 band 80–120 mm (schematic mid 100). Leaf tail cue ~300 mm for readable seams.
semantics.parallelTracks: One ground track per leaf plane (3 for default).

drawingCues: 3 overlapping segments with depth ghosts at seams
Plan strip under elevation: parallel stacked leaves
Motor-side front-face marker on lead panel
Guide portal on parking post; receiver on latch post
Dashed stack zone + motor pad outside parking post
doNotMislead: Do not draw a single flat leaf (reads as tracked).
Do not hide overlaps with tiny seams.
Do not treat 2-leaf Combiarialdo as FROM default.
Do not draw stack as a hole inside the clear opening.
Live mm stay in the UI strip under the image.

lookup.description: First matching rule wins. Topology always = 3 overlapping panels + N tracks + plan cue.

plannedVariants.title: 2-leaf (Combiarialdo / L=C/2+300)
plannedVariants.note: Product VARIANT — not FROM default. Ship only if Marius lists it as sellable option.
